beats.summary: Michael attempts to explain his business model to business students and faces challenging questions.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Okay, I'm seeing some confused… faces out there. Let me slow down a little bit.
Business Student #1: Sir, as a company that primary distributes paper, how have you adapted your business model to function in an increasingly paperless world?

beats.summary: Michael defends Dunder-Mifflin against business students' skepticism about competing with nationwide chains.

evidence.snippet: Michael: David will always beat Goliath.
Business Student #2: But how can you compete against a company with the resources of a nationwide chain?

beats.summary: Michael angrily criticizes the business students and Ryan, then abruptly leaves the classroom.
Michael tells Ryan he is being moved to the annex instead of being fired.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Fire you? No, no no. You are moving… to the annex.
